title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: As part of climate interventions in ‘Le Chéile: Together for an inclusive better world, this project will advocate and support the integration of climate action into citizenship and political participation work. It is a fundamental human right for people living with disabilities to have their voices heard in decisions that affect their wellbeing. Climate change affects all people; therefore, it is imperative that climate actions and policies include everyone. However, without a systemic process in place to ensure the participation of all stakeholders, the appropriate changes desired by people with disabilities may not be considered in the development of policies. This project aims to address this gap by promoting the participation of the Senegalese Federation of Associations of People with Disabilities (FSAPH) in the CDN (Contribution Déterminée Nationale à l'Accord de Paris sur le Climat) to ensure that disability is considered in the sectorial plans. Sightsavers will work with the Ministry of Environment on climate change by advocating for representation of persons with disabilities in the national and regional committees. Other activities include engaging with youth with disabilities on their membership and participation in climate action movements or supporting youth associations to have an interest in climate action.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Increased integration of climate action initiatives, especially on climate adaptation and mitigation, into citizenship and political participation work in Senegal.. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Adaptation: - The project will advocate for and support the participation of people with disabilities organisations to engage in policy and decision-making processes on climate change ensuring their voices are heard and included at the national and regional level.
